id.rule: Section 3: lowercase UUID, not nil; strict tier: version 4 with RFC 4122 variant bits

created_at.rule: Section 3, Section 6 step 4: RFC 3339, a real calendar date, no leap second
created_at.detail: form and calendar validity only, not that the time is true (Section 13)

tool.rule: Table 1: an object with name, version and scope

provenance_class.rule: Section 5: one of the three classes

output_hash.rule: Section 4, Section 6 step 3: sha256 of the decoded canonical bytes equals output_hash

canonical_byte_length.rule: profile member, not in the draft: the decoded length

metadata_hash.rule: Section 3.1, Section 6 step 4: the metadata block recomputed from the stored members (id, created_at, tool, provenance_class, schema version, output_hash)

committed_version_and_class.rule: kit rule 11 (read with the draft): the version and provenance class inside the canonical bytes equal the outer members

outer_copies_of_committed_members.rule: profile: the outer caller, side_effects and tool equal the committed ones

verification_status.rule: Table 1: "verified" when the stored record passes Section 6
verification_status.detail: 'commitment_matches': Section 6 names "commitment_matches" as the passing value of the deprecated version 1 API, which served this record (api_version 1)

input_hash.rule: Section 3.3: a verifier that cannot reproduce the recorded input under a published layout MUST NOT report the commitment as confirmed
input_hash.detail: the canonical bytes record no input, and the layout is named ('zambo-json-sorted-keys-utf8-v1'), not published in the receipt. Reconstruction: {"symbol": "BTC"} from provenance.request.symbol and job_summary (both outside every commitment), serialized as the layout's name reads (sorted members, no whitespace, UTF-8): its sha256 equals input_hash. input_hash is outside metadata_hash (Section 3.3) and outside the canonical bytes: anyone holding the receipt can change it without affecting any other check

anchor_report.rule: Section 6 per-anchor report: present / evaluated / outcome

profile_anchor_offline.status: consistent offline; the Nostr event not checked
profile_anchor_offline.rule: not Section 10: the anchor is in the profile's shape 'zambo-receipt-anchor/1', not Table 4's (type, version, receipt_id, anchored_digest, anchor_type, anchored_at, proof)

nostr.checked: no: no relay was contacted; the event's signature, its content and its created_at are not verified here (Section 10.1 step 3 needs the relay)

evidence.detail: 61 bytes from https://api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/BTC-USD/spot, digest sha256:4056f1856dd385fe98c9ce4cd7a1d182b266e2540ee791c01fcb75048fc252df (equal to provenance.response_sha256); the bytes were not fetched

issuer.rule: draft -26 core: no signature member; the receipt's own checks say so
issuer.detail: A zambo.dev receipt URL does not authenticate the issuer; no pinned signature or trusted issuer key was checked.
